answer: Leaving requires filing on the tundra registry: the identity's 80-credit bond moves into an island escrow for six epochs. There it earns nothing, funds no new identity, and stays open to ferrous audits; an auditor proving fraud burns the whole bond. The k-th fake still posts fresh 80 credits, so 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 credits for six epochs, with no bond recycled. Rented exits fail: the ferrous record binds escrow to the original key, so a rented key carries its audit history and burns on proven fraud. An honest identity files once and recovers its 80 credits after one cooldown.
